app.name: ResQNet
app.tagline: One Signal. One Network. Rapid Rescue.
app.subtitle: Real-time emergency response platform powered by location intelligence, weather analytics, and offline mesh resilience.

landing.heroTitle: One Signal. One Network. Rapid Rescue.
landing.heroSubtitle: Real-time emergency response platform powered by location intelligence, weather analytics, and offline mesh resilience.
landing.step1Desc: Citizen triggers SOS with accurate GPS coordinates in 1 tap.
landing.step2Desc: Precise location coordinates captured with accuracy rating.
landing.step3Desc: Priority score calculated based on severity and medical status.
landing.step4Desc: Nearest available rescue team automatically assigned.
landing.step5Desc: Citizen tracks approaching rescue team on live GIS map.
landing.step6Desc: Rescue verified by Command Center and moved to Solved queue.
landing.offlineTitle: Works Even When Mobile Towers Fail
landing.offlineDesc: ResQ-Mesh uses software-defined phone-to-phone gossip relay over Bluetooth & Wi-Fi so emergency signals hop from phone to phone until reaching rescue teams.
landing.weatherTitle: Proactive Weather Intelligence Before Disasters Hit
landing.weatherDesc: Real-time rainfall telemetry and risk polygon mapping enable rapid pre-positioning of rescue boats and evacuation shelter readiness.
landing.featOfflineDesc: Send emergency signals without mobile network or internet.
landing.featWeatherDesc: Real-time precipitation forecasting and inundation risk mapping.
landing.featTrackingDesc: Track assigned rescue vehicle position and distance in real time.
landing.featMapDesc: Multi-layer Leaflet spatial mapping for tactical command operations.
landing.featMultilangDesc: Instant dynamic switching between English, Telugu, and Hindi.
landing.featPWADesc: Installable web app with local offline storage capability.
landing.disclaimer: ResQNet is a hackathon prototype designed for intelligent disaster management.
